messages:
alice: Quick PSA — we're seeing a spike of SIEM hits tied to `kms.decrypt` audit events starting ~02:10 UTC after the RBAC tweak last night. Lots of low-value noise.
ben: saw it, spikes are from `infra-kms-rotator` service account, ~1200 events in 5m. dashboards blown up.
carol: SIEM bot posted: ALERT flood: 1200 x kms.decrypt from infra-kms-rotator (rule: high-frequency-kms-decrypt). See <https://siem.redwood.example/r/alerts/7851|alert link>
dave: can we confirm these were expected rotations from the rotation job? task logs show run at 02:05 with 30 keys rotated across regions.
alice: yep rotation job is normal, but the audit entries are being emitted per-region-per-key and our rule treats each as a distinct source -> threshold trip.
ben: current rule snippet: ```
rule high-frequency-kms-decrypt {
  when event.action == "kms.decrypt" and event.count > 100
  group by src_user
}
```
alice: edge case: `src_user` for the rotator is changing per-region because of the impersonation header, so group-by doesn't aggregate. rule should group by `service_account_id` or `principal.email` instead.
carol: proposed quick fix: change `group by src_user` -> `group by service_account_id` and add suppression for known rotation jobs: ```
not (event.source == "rotation-job" and event.action == "kms.decrypt")
```
dave: small gotcha — the SIEM rule parser treats `not (A and B)` differently when parentheses omitted. we need explicit parentheses to avoid accidentally dropping A-only matches.
ben: also suggest a short-term tactical patch: add a suppression window for that alert id until we confirm parsing change, e.g., mute alert 7851 for 30m.
alice: agreed. I'll mute 7851 for 30m and create a GA ticket to update rule syntax + add test case.
carol: assign to ben for rule change + unit test in the SIEM repo, and to dave for verifying the rotation job emits `service_account_id` consistently across regions.
ben: will open PR with rule change and unit tests, linking to inspection logs. PR will include this test snippet: ```
# test: rotation job events aggregate to single src
input = [ {"action":"kms.decrypt","service_account_id":"infra-kms-rotator","region":"us-east-1"}, ... ]
expect aggregated_count == 1
```
dave: I'll check rotation payloads and tag the job so SIEM gets `rotation-job` in `event.source`.
alice: comms: I'll post short note to #incidents about suppressed noisy alert and ETA for fix. cc: @oncall.emoji: :rotating_light:
siem-bot: Mute applied to alert 7851 by alice (expires in 30m).
carol: postmortem note: add this to SIEM playbook — when an RBAC/rotation rollout happens, pre-emptively add suppression rule or update grouping keys.
ben: one more thought — add a dashboard tile that breaks down `kms.decrypt` by `service_account_id` so we can quickly spot legit vs noisy.
alice: action items summarized: mute alert 7851 (done), ben -> PR for rule change + tests, dave -> standardize rotation payloads, carol -> update playbook + dashboard request. I'll follow up in 45m with status.
